answer: The tide-mirror check admits newcomers only through one inlet. At each tide every newcomer posts a $5 bond and files a mirror copy of its work record with the inlet ledger; within three hours two keepers compare each mirror against the ledger, and a copied record, a second claim, or a missed tide burns the bond. One newcomer risks $5 and an afternoon; faking a hundred means a hundred forged mirrors and $500 locked.
